Hi Elliot —

Thanks again for making time for the final loop with the Platform team next Thursday (June 20). Quick details and a short agenda attached — please reply to confirm the ASL request and any additional needs so we can lock things in.

Agenda (short):
- 9:30–10:00 — Welcome + recruiting check-in (Lauren)
- 10:00–11:15 — System design + infra deep dive (Karthik, Marissa)
- 11:15–11:45 — Async systems Q&A + next steps

We can offer: live ASL interpreter, live captions (webcaptioning), an escorted path from the lobby to the interview room, and a Zoom fallback link if you prefer to join remotely at the last minute. I've attached the accommodation form and the final agenda.

Also: are you planning to come by rideshare or public transit? We can pre-book a pickup or provide reimbursement — let me know a pickup window if you'd like pre-booked.

Attachments:
- agenda-final.pdf (2pg)
- candidate-accommodations-form.pdf (fillable)

Thanks — we want this to be as low-friction as possible.

—Lauren Bishop

Hi Lauren —

Thanks — confirmed for Thursday. I do need an ASL interpreter and would like live captions on the projector (I lip-read when possible but rely on captions). I filled out the accommodations form and attached it here (please confirm you received it).

Pickup: public transit is best for me; I may take a Lyft if the schedule changes. If you can provide a rideshare stipend that would be great — I’ll send the receipt after.

Appreciate the heads-up on the agenda. Can you also confirm whether there’s a quiet room available between rounds? I sometimes need a ~10 minute break in a low-stimulus space.

Best,
Elliot

2) Quiet room:
   - Vanessa: can you reserve Quiet Room B on 3rd floor for 9:00–12:00 and add a 10-min buffer after the system design slot?
3) Escort & lobby pickup:
   - Vanessa: assign an escort to meet Elliot at the lobby at 9:20 — provide escort phone number to Lauren for the candidate.
4) Rideshare stipend:
   - Lauren: confirm stipend policy (expense up to $40) and we’ll cover receipt-based reimbursement.
5) Zoom fallback & passkey:
   - Stephanie: create a Zoom host passkey and upload the passkey stub to the Drive folder below. In case of last-minute remote join we’ll share: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=ABCDEF (passkey attached).
6) AV & captions test:
   - Karthik (me): I’ll run a 15-min AV + captions test with interpreter on Wed 6/19 at 3:30pm PT — please join if you’re available.

Attachments referenced: agenda-final.pdf, candidate-accommodations-form.pdf, zoom-passkey.txt
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D-accessibility-ops
